Apply For License


S.No Steps to be followed Link for the same
1 Application process starts with identification of Indian Standard against the product for which license is desired.  
2 Indian Standard against a product can be searched and downloaded from the URL View
3 Once the standard is identified the manufacturers are requested to analyse and document the requisite manufacturing infrastructure, appropriate process controls, quality control and testing capabilities for the product as per relevant Indian Standard (ISS)  
4 For guidance of manufacturers, BIS has developed product specific technical manuals which can be accessed form the URL View
5 The Bureau grants the licence based on successful assessment of the manufacturing infrastructure, process controls, quality control and testing capabilities of the manufacturer through a visit to its manufacturing premises and Conformity of the product to the relevant standard(s) is also established through third party laboratory testing or testing in the manufacturing premises or a combination of both.  
5 There are two options available for obtaining BIS product certification licence under Scheme – I. For details, please see Guidelines for grant of licence URL View
6 Please refer to the URL View
7 To know about details of fee (application, inspection & annual license fee). Product specific Marking Fees can be also be searched from the URL View
8 The applications are accepted only through online mode including all payments. To submit your application, please visit our online portal, www.manakonline.in
9 For any further queries or clarification you may also contact our ROs/BOs from this link
